root_cause: Arrow key navigation in Pikaday does not respect the disableDayFn callback, allowing movement onto disabled weekend days.
repair_strategy: Modify the adjustDate method to repeatedly add or subtract one day until the resulting date is not disabled by disableDayFn, while respecting min/max bounds and using a safety iteration limit.
expected_accessibility_effect: ArrowRight will now skip weekends, moving from Friday to the next Monday, satisfying WCAG 2.1.1 keyboard accessibility for date selection.
functional_risks: Potential infinite loop if disableDayFn always returns true and min/max do not bound the search; mitigated by iteration limit and boundary checks.
Performance impact if large date ranges are traversed, but limited by the safety cap of 1000 iterations.
Ensure that min/max constraints still take precedence over disableDayFn skipping.
verification_requirements: Verify that ArrowRight from Friday 2026-11-20 results in 2026-11-23 (Monday).
Verify that ArrowLeft from Monday 2026-11-23 results in 2026-11-20 (Friday).
Confirm that minDate and maxDate constraints still prevent navigation beyond those bounds.
Ensure that dates marked disabled by disableDayFn cannot be selected via mouse or keyboard.
